messages:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: http_5xx_rate > 4.5% in ap-southeast1 (5m window) — sources: edge-proxy-usw2->apac-ingress. Pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC12345 triggered (High). Notifying rotation.

sarah.nguyen: ack'd. I'm on it — switching to incident channel.

kevin_b: saw the spike in logs — lots of TLS reneg handshake failures followed by 502 from apac-proxy pool. Sample logs: ```
[apac-proxy-3] tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: illegal_parameter
upstream: 502 from model-gateway-1
```

maria-ops: Confirmed increased conn resets on ap-southeast1 LB. Healthchecks show flaps. Rolling traffic to fallback pool (apac-fallback-gpu) now via routing rule.

raj: Applying routing change. Patching route weight: apac-primary -> 10%, apac-fallback -> 90%. Will monitor. Command: `infractl route adjust --region ap-southeast1 --to apac-fallback --weight 90`

thomas: Noted KV cache evictions around same time — could be cascading. Watching memcaches. If cache warmup causing backend surge, might need to throttle warmup.

alice-support: Customer impact: elevated 5xx for a subset of API keys originating from APAC. Support ticket volume +3x. Posting banner to status page?

sarah.nguyen: Yes, please post a short status: "Degraded: API error rate elevated for APAC region; mitigation in progress." I'll draft.

maria-ops: Routing change applied, healthchecks stabilizing on fallback pool. 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 2.1% over the last 2m.

kevin_b: For root cause, looks like a cert renewal agent on apac-edge triggered renegotiation under load. Patch rolling back the agent on apac-edge nodes. Patch job started: `kubectl -n infra set image daemonset/edge-cert-rotator edge-rotator:v2026.04-revert`

incident-bot: NOTE: auto-escalation timer at 10m. Current ack: sarah.nguyen.

raj: Can someone run a quick smoke using curl to verify endpoints? `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Host: api.example.com" https://apac.example.com/v1/generate`

thomas: ran smoke from eu-west1: 200, latency 220ms. Ran from ap-southeast1: 502 -> 200 after route change.

kevin_b: rollback of rotator agent completed on 6/6 apac nodes. Monitoring for further TLS renegotiation errors.

maria-ops: Rebalanced connection draining windows shorter to reduce handshake retries. Observed client retry storms from some SDK versions — temporarily disabled aggressive client-side retries in the edge proxy config: `retry_policy: max_retries: 1`

alice-support: Status update posted: https://status.example.com/incidents/INC12345 — message: "Investigating elevated error rate in APAC; traffic redirected to fallback pool; mitigation underway."

incident-bot: Metrics snapshot: peak 5xx rate 8.7% at t=1777774300, current 5xx rate 1.9% (5m avg). Latency p95 APAC 420ms -> 310ms.

raj: Will keep traffic on fallback until full verification. Plan: 30m observation, then gradual shift back if stable.

kevin_b: Next: postmortem owners: kevin_b (lead), maria-ops (infra), sarah.nguyen (oncall comms). I'll start a draft.

alice-support: Filing impacted customer list from logs and opening outbound messages for top 10 customers.

thomas: Please capture the exact agent version that triggered the issue: `edge-rotator:v2026.04` — include in postmortem.

sarah.nguyen: Good work team. I'll hand off to oncall-next at 1777775521 (20m). Leaving channel; partial handoff notes posted in #oncall-handoff.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: automatic notify to next on-call in 10m if no status update.

maria-ops: Monitoring looks stable for last 6m. I'll keep a 1hr watch.

kevin_b: Closing note for thread: mitigation successful; 5xx rates back to baseline after rollback + route failover. Postmortem WIP.

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 resolved (monitoring).
